entries.title: Lamentations 5:1
segments: Remember, O LORD, what has been to us; look down and see our shame.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:2
segments: Our inheritance has turned to aliens, our houses to foreigners.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:3
segments: We are orphans and fatherless; our mothers [are] as widows.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:4
segments: We have drunk our water for silver; our wood comes for a price.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:5
segments: We [are] pursued on our necks; we grow weary; rest is not given to us.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:6
segments: We have given the hand [to] Egypt, to Assyria, to be satisfied with bread.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:7
segments: Our fathers have sinned [and are] not; we have borne their iniquities.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:8
segments: Servants rule over us; [there is] no rescuer out of their hand.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:9
segments: We bring in our bread with our souls, because of the sword of the wilderness.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:10
segments: Our skin [is] hot like an oven because of the fever heat of famine.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:11
segments: They raped the women in Zion, virgins in the cities of Judah.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:12
segments: Rulers were hanged by the hand; the faces of elders were not honored.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:13
segments: They took the young men [to] grind, and the youths stumbled at the wood.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:14
segments: The elders have ceased from the gate, the young men from their music.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:15
segments: The joy of our heart has ceased; our dance has turned into mourning.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:16
segments: The crown has fallen [from] our head. Woe now to us! For we have sinned.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:17
segments: Our heart is faint for this; our eyes are dim for these [things].

entries.title: Lamentations 5:18
segments: On the mountain of Zion [is] laid waste, the foxes walk on it.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:19
segments: You, O LORD, remain forever; Your throne to generation and generation.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:20
segments: Why do You forget us forever [and] forsake us the length of days?

entries.title: Lamentations 5:21
segments: Return us to You, O LORD, and we will turn; renew our days as of old,

entries.title: Lamentations 5:22
segments: unless You have utterly rejected us; You are very angry against us.
